claims.quote: Psalidodon balbus is a small characid known only from upper Paraná basin headwaters in the Federal District and Goiás, central Brazil.
Known only from headwaters of the upper Paraná river basin in the Federal District plus the neighbouring state of Goiás, central Brazil.
